viewing_check: Photograph the hour meter and confirm hours (catalogue says 40.7). Check engine plate/Yanmar model, serial plate 210003, RDT-11B plate, boom decal ('QM 12-3'?), hydraulic leaks, track and blade wear, that it starts and runs, quick hitch fit to the attachments, and whether the auger drive and all buckets are present. Check for a 'Hire' fleet history, registration or finance/PPSR status, and the age of the canopy.
